QuestInfo.name: Prepare for Seal Removal
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p3001000##k and receive the next mission.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001000##k tells you that the research on seal ritual has been completed and you should get the details on the military operations from #b#p3001102##k over at #r#m401040000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p3001102##k told you what to do next. Get ready for battle!

0.0: Back from your infiltrating so soon?\r\n#L0##bI'm super strong. You're in a good mood.#l\n#k
0.1: Don't judge a book by its cover. I'm just relieved to be done with the seal ritual research. We'll be able to open the castle doors as if we had the keys.\r\n#L0##bJust like old times.#l\n#k
0.2: If you need any more rest, or if you have matters to attend to, do it. We're going inside that castle and we might not be coming back. \r\n#L0##bI'm always ready. My body is a temple of strength.#l\n#k
0.3: If you're that prepared, go see #b#p3001102##k. I will take my place at the castle gate and ready it for your entry. Are you ready?

yes.0: Talk to #b#p3001102##k at the #m401040000#, and prepare for battle.

no.0: Don't go into this battle unless you're at 100%. There's too much at stake.

1.0: Sorry to throw you right back into the thick of it, Kaiser, but this is the time for all of us to grit our teeth and claim victory.
1.1: The next fight is going to be our biggest. Your job is to protect #b#p3001000##k from Specters while she opens the castle doors.
1.2: After that, you need to clear out as many Specter troops as possible before they have time to form ranks. Let me know when you're prepared for battle.
